risks: Minimal: routine data. Small subgroups (for example women new to the country at one hub) could be identifiable, so cells under five are suppressed.
consent: No individual consent for routine data under the service evaluation classification; the service's privacy notice covers evaluation.
data: Pseudonymised extract prepared by the maternity information team; invoices contain no personal data.
equity: PROGRESS-Plus: women under 20, women new to the country, women needing interpreters and women in deprived areas attend least; results are reported for each, and interpreter costs are presented as a cost of equitable care, not a reason against it.
effectiveness: Estimates whether offering group care raises attendance and at what cost per additional attender.
partnerships: Community midwives, the finance team, a maternity voices partnership and an interpreter service lead.
rebPath: Service evaluation (SEV-MAT-2026-21); no research ethics review required. Publication would follow CHEERS 2022.
limitations: Non-random hub selection; the evidence base retrieved was only two records.
summary: Minimal-risk service evaluation with equity reporting.
